alloy: all u: Unit | (unfounded[u] or miscited[u] or circular[u]) implies u in Finding
all u: Unit | unfounded[u] implies u in Freelancing
all b: Bug | (some u: Unit | cites[b, u] and u not in Spec) implies b in Misnesting
all c: Conflict | (some u: Unit | cites[c, u]) implies c in Misnesting
all t: Term | (some u: Unit | cites[t, u]) implies t in Misnesting
all c: Conflict | (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i not in Known) implies c in Mistracking
doubt: 'it' read as the conflict (an issue cannot carry a finding).

alloy: all c: Conflict | (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) implies c in OutdatedTracking
all c: Conflict | not paired[c] implies c in Unpairing
all t: Test | (some c: Claim | checks[t, c] and refined[c]) implies t in Overreach
all p: Pointer | (no x: Target | p->x in Name.pointer) implies p in Rotting
all u1: Unit | (some u: Unit | u1->u in Repeat.rel) implies u1 in Rotting
all f: Fence | f in BoundsWord implies f in BoundsBlock
all f: Fence | f in ScenarioWord implies f in ScenarioBlock
all f: Fence | f in NoSecondWord implies f in UnitBlock
all d: Document | ((no f: Listing | d->f in Head.rel) and d not in Given) implies (no p: Plugin | p->d in Over.rel)
all d: Document, f: Listing, p: Plugin | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and not lists[f, p] and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
all f: Dangling | f in Refused
all f: Looping | f in Refused
all f: Stray | f in Frontmatter and f in Refused
all r: Run | (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies r in Exits2
all c: Command | available[c] implies c not in Unknown
all r: Run, p: Plugin | calls[r, p] implies (r->p in Return.code0 or r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2)
doubt: '0, 1 or 2' read as inclusive or, not exactly one.

alloy: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits1)
some d1, d2, d3: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel and d2->d3 in Extend.rel and d3 != d1 and d1->d3 in Context.rel
doubt: No distinctness of d2 from the others is stated, so none is required.

alloy: some d: Document, f: Listing, p: Installed, r: Run | d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p] and p->d in Over.rel and calls[r, p] and r->p in Return.code1 and r in Exits1
some r1: Run, d1: Document, f1: Refused | d1->f1 in Head.rel and d1 in Unreadable and r1 in Exits2
all u: Unit | u in Unsayable implies u in Explained
all r: Run, u: Unit | ((r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel or r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel) and u in Faulted) implies (r not in Exits0 and u not in Explained)
doubt: The run and the unit are not linked by any relation; read as any unit of the model.

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Rewritten implies (u in Unwritten or u in Stale)) and ((u in Unwritten or u in Stale) implies u in Rewritten)
all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared
all u: Unit, w: Word | (u not in Term and u->w in Introduce.rel) implies w in Misplaced
all u1: Unit, w1: Word | (u1->w1 in Voice.rel and (some u: Unit | u->w1 in Introduce.rel) and u1->w1 not in Introduce.rel) implies w1 in Apart
all u: Unit | u in BareFormula implies u in Held
all s: Search | s in First implies s not in Trial
all s1: Search, c1: Scenario | (s1 in Trial and s1->c1 in Pose.scenario) implies (c1 in Impossible and s1 in Afterwards)
all u, v: Unit | (u != v and u->v in Share.rel) implies u->v in Together.rel
doubt: 'another' read as a different unit; without it the u != v guard drops.

alloy: all u, v: Unit | (u != v and u->v in Together.rel) implies u->v in Chain.rel
doubt: 'another' read as a different unit; without it the u != v guard drops.

alloy: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no s: Scenario | s in Raised) and (no u1: Unit | u1 in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1->w not in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, w: Word | w not in Signature implies u->w not in Expose.rel
doubt: 'never' read as a plain invariant; the model has no mutable state, so 'always' would add nothing.

alloy: all t: Term, w: Word | t->w not in Expose.rel
all d: Definition | (d in OrInsideKind and byKind[d]) implies d in OneCoordination
all d: Definition | (d in OneKind and byKind[d]) implies d in OneSentenceKind
all d1: Definition | d1 in NoKindFirst implies d1 in AsItStands
all q: Quantifier | q in TimedCondition implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in ConditionAside implies q in InFull
all s: Series | sentenceable[s] implies s in AsSentence
all s: Series | (s in Items and not sentenceable[s]) implies s in AsBullets
all s: Series | s in TimeFirst implies s in ThenOwnLine
all s: Series | (s in Rule and s not in OneLineRule) implies s in ThenOwnLine
some q1: Quantifier | q1 in VariableOnce and q1 in NoWithAnother
some s: Series | s in PairInList and s in NotClause
some s: Series | s in TimeSecond and s not in OneLineRule
doubt: 'can be' read as a possibility (some), not a rule.

alloy: some s: Series | s in OneLineRule and s in TimeFirst
